title: UNIQON Billing Pro • Android Build 295 (Theme Tab Swipe Toggle, Back Navigation Loop Fix, Onboarding UI Alignment & Pro Lock Protection)
highlights: Swipe Between Tabs On/Off Control: Users can enable or disable horizontal swiping gestures in Settings > Theme & Appearance.
Fixed Back Navigation Loop: Resolved issue where pressing back after swiping only bounced between two tabs.
First Install PRO Lock: PC Builder and Barcode Stickers are locked by default on first install, protected by Owner Master PIN.
Fixed Backup Storage UI Overlap: Realigned Backup Storage Location badge and folder path card during initial onboarding.
fixes: Added tabSwipeEnabledNotifier and setting switch in App Theme & Appearance.
Fixed MenuNavigationHistory cycle truncation to allow smooth multi-step back navigation.
Cleaned up Backup Storage Location badge collision and styled path display in first install onboarding.
Guarded mobile dashboard quick access cards with TenantContext module enablement.
Updated Android release package to Build 295.
